sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Trained_In"."Treatment" AS e, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Trained_In" GROUP BY "Trained_In"."Treatment"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s3"."m1" AS REAL) / "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: share of the all total of number of Trained_In records (all level)
index against the all average of number of Trained_In records (all level)
